title: ProductEngine registry — decode → guard → dispatch (arch item C)
description: celnet-server::price_instrument is refactored from an inline product match into decode → guard → dispatch over a per-family ProductEngine registry (crates/celnet-server/src/pricer/engines.rs). Each of the 24 product arms is a distinct ProductEngine impl, and pricing is byte-identical to the celnet-parity price corpus. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'product-engine-registry'.

assertions.statement: engines::dispatch matches on instrument::Product and routes each of the 24 product arms (Vanilla … ListedFutureOption) to a distinct ProductEngine impl — the dispatch function has exactly 24 callees, one per family, with no pricing logic inline in the match.

ProductEngine::price is the single per-family seam every product engine implements; a new product family plugs in by adding a ProductEngine impl plus one dispatch arm, never by editing price_instrument.

price_instrument is decode → guard → dispatch: after the term-shape, asset-class-routing and FX carry guards it delegates the FX/analytic product path to engines::dispatch (a single static call into the registry) with no product match inline.
The registry dispatch is byte-identical (to_bits equality) to the former inline product match across the celnet-parity price corpus — the refactor changes structure, not numbers.
